title: Archetype costs re-priced, every build reset
changes: 58 attribute costs went up and 29 went down across all 13 archetypes.
Attacking Positioning is no longer a specialization requirement.
Every Pro's attribute points were reset; levels and totals were kept.
Players with a Pro got 5,000 Club Coins and a 1.75x AXP boost for 6 matches.

source.title: EA, The Grounds developer archetypes update

siteNote: Pro Clubs HQ reports the level cap rose from 40 to 55 the same day; EA's page doesn't say (O-02).
